If you own an iPhone 16 or newer, you'll likely want a Qi2.2 charger to fully take advantage of the 25W MagSafe charging speeds your phone supports. Anker's brand-new 25W Prime MagSafe 3-in-1 charger is one of the best options out there, with an extremely portable design.

First impressions

A major trend in the second half of 2025 has been bringing 25W Qi2.2 to every wireless charging accessory imaginable, and that trend is continuing into 2026. Anker is leading the charge with a brand-new portable MagSafe 3-in-1 charger, packing 25W Qi2.2 support into an extremely portable design.

With wireless charging speeds hitting 25W, active cooling is practically a must-have. Nearly every 25W charger on the market includes built-in cooling, and Anker's new foldable 3-in-1 charger is no exception.

In the box, you'll find a 45W charging brick and a USB-C cable, which is enough power to charge your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch simultaneously. With this charging stand, you can get your iPhone 18 Pro to 50% in just 27 minutes.

Remember the MagSafe Duo? If you loved that product but were disappointed when Apple discontinued it, you're going to love this. It's just as portable as the MagSafe Duo, but with two major improvements: it doubles as a desktop charging stand, and it can charge three devices at once instead of two.

One rather interesting (though entirely unnecessary) feature of this charger is that the Apple Watch charger is spring-loaded. When the charger is folded up, it folds inward, but when you're ready to unfold it for use, it pops out with a simple press down. I found this design to be quite clever, and it helps justify the premium price point the product commands.

Final verdict

Overall, if you're looking for a great MagSafe 3-in-1 charger that's perfect for travel, Anker's new offering is a very solid choice. With active cooling built in, it'll fast-charge your iPhone quickly while avoiding the overheating or other negative issues that sometimes plague wireless charging.

Anker's new 3-in-1 MagSafe charger is now available on Amazon for $99 with Prime shipping, in both black and white color options.
